name: Swarm alpha refuses barred identities and their anchors

adoption.authority: The account the membership contract named as its adopter

actions.effect: Proceeding makes the subject a member. Refusing does not.

deny.list: Anchors of identities barred from swarm alpha (DENY, DERIVED)
deny.why: The group decided that the refusal of an identity reaches the account bound to it.

standing: The caller is the account, or owns the agent identity or is approved for it.
updates: Follows both lists. Amended by the adopter.
workInProgress: Joining is decided every time. Membership already held, and anything a member has earned, is not touched by this binding.
